items.title: New workspaces reach five active users without a CSM call
items.problem: Mid-market admins invite users one at a time; median time from signup to 5 active users is 10 days, 38% of trials never reach it, and CSMs spend about 2 hours per account walking admins through setup.

drivers.statement: Revenue: trial-to-paid conversion in the mid-market segment is 14% against a 20% plan
Cost: onboarding calls consume 1.5 CSM FTE that the plan assigns to expansion

items.outcome: An admin can bring their team in on day 1 on their own, and most trials reach 5 active users in the first 2 days.
non_goals: SCIM provisioning (planned for the enterprise tier)

items.title: Median days from signup to 5 active users falls from 10 to 2
items.metric: Median days from workspace creation to the 5th user with a session, from the product analytics 'activation' funnel

items.title: Onboarding calls per new mid-market account fall from 1 to 0.2
items.metric: CSM calls tagged 'onboarding' per new mid-market account per month, from the CRM

items.title: Admins import their team from a CSV
items.description: Workspace admins upload a CSV of names and emails, see row-level validation before anything is created, and send all invitations in one step.
items.benefit_hypothesis: We believe bulk CSV import will let admins invite their whole team in one sitting; we will know when median days to 5 active users is 4 or fewer for workspaces created after Release 4.2.

items.title: Admin uploads a CSV and sees row-level validation
items.i_want: to upload a CSV of up to 500 users and see which rows are invalid before anyone is invited
items.so_that: I fix mistakes once instead of chasing failed invitations

acceptance.given: a CSV with 500 rows, 3 of them with malformed emails
acceptance.then: the preview lists 497 valid rows and exactly 3 errors with their row numbers within 5 seconds
the upload is refused with the message 'Up to 500 users per file' and no row is stored

acceptance.given: a row whose email already belongs to a workspace member
acceptance.then: that row is marked 'already a member' and is excluded from the 497 count

items.title: Admin sends every valid invitation in one step
items.i_want: to send invitations to all valid rows from the preview with one confirmation
items.so_that: my team gets access on day 1

acceptance.then: 497 invitation emails are queued within 60 seconds and the admin sees a summary with 0 failures
the summary lists those 2 addresses with the provider's reason and a 'resend' action

items.title: Setup checklist guides admins through the first day
items.description: A five-step checklist on the admin home page covers inviting users, creating the first project, connecting the calendar, setting roles, and booking optional help, and reports completion to Customer Success.
items.benefit_hypothesis: We believe a guided checklist will answer the questions CSMs answer on onboarding calls; we will know when onboarding calls per new account fall below 0.5 within 6 weeks of Release 4.3.

items.title: Admin home page shows a five-step setup checklist
items.as_a: workspace admin in my first 14 days
items.i_want: a checklist that shows which of the 5 setup steps I have finished and links to each
items.so_that: I can finish setup without booking a call

acceptance.given: a workspace created in the last 14 days
acceptance.when: the admin opens the home page
acceptance.then: the checklist shows all 5 steps with each finished step ticked

acceptance.given: the admin has finished all 5 steps
acceptance.then: the checklist collapses to a single 'Setup complete' line and a 'setup_complete' event is sent to the CRM within 10 minutes

items.title: Decide whether SSO setup belongs in the checklist
items.i_want: a 5-day research spike on how many new mid-market admins need SSO in week 1, ending in a decision to add or leave out an SSO step
items.so_that: the checklist covers the setup that actually blocks teams

acceptance.given: CRM notes and support tickets for the last 120 new mid-market accounts
acceptance.then: a decision note states the share of accounts that needed SSO in week 1 and recommends add or leave out

items.title: CSV preview rejects valid emails with a plus sign
items.observed: Rows such as 'ana+ops@example.com' are flagged 'malformed email' in the preview (support ticket 48213, 3 accounts affected on 2027-03-24).
items.expected: Plus-addressed emails are valid, so they count as valid rows (S-1.1).
steps: Create a CSV with the row 'Ana Ops,ana+ops@example.com'
Upload it as a workspace admin

acceptance.then: all 10 rows are valid and 0 errors are listed
exactly 1 error is listed for that row
